name: labs/gregmoille__instrumentcontrol
title: Tektronix DPO70000 oscilloscope
intro: Tektronix DPO70000 oscilloscope, adapted from gregmoille/instrumentcontrol. It reads `acquisition_mode_actual`, `acquisition_num_acquisitions`, `acquisition_num_averages`, `acquisition_num_envelopes` and 2 more; sets `acquisition_mode`, `acquisition_num_samples`, `acquisition_sampling_mode`, `acquisition_state` and 5 more. A hardware driver: the market serves its fake backend, so no instrument is needed.
